edges.reason: msg.sender determines which balance is debited in transfer, tying caller identity to authorization.
msg.sender is used to read and decrement the caller allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner granting the allowance in approve.
constructor assigns the entire supply to msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged holder.
msg.sender indexes the _balances mapping to mint the initial supply during construction.
Parameter _to flows into the destination balance update of transfer.
Parameter _value flows into the amount used by transfer.
Parameter _from flows into the source balance and allowance deduction of transferFrom.
Parameter _to flows into the destination balance update of transferFrom.
Parameter _value flows into the amount used by transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance recipient in approve.
Parameter _value is stored as the allowance in approve.
Parameter _owner indexes _balances in the balanceOf query.
Parameter _owner indexes the _allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter _spender indexes the _allowed mapping in allowance.
Local c stores the product computed inside safeMul.
transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the _balances mapping for source and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements the _allowed mapping entry of the caller.
approve writes the _allowed mapping entry for msg.sender and _spender.
allowance reads the _allowed mapping for the owner and spender pair.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the _balances mapping.
The raw addition in transfer consumes the unchecked balance value before the overflow guard.
The unchecked addition result gates the require statement execution path of transfer.
The raw addition in transferFrom consumes the unchecked recipient balance.
The unchecked addition result gates the require statement execution path of transferFrom.
decimals feeds the raw exponentiation and multiplication that computes the supply.
The unchecked multiplication result is assigned to the totalSupply state variable.
The constructor reads totalSupply when crediting the deployer balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeSub for the source balance and the allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
The payable fallback reverts, preventing any callback-driven state interaction with the contract.
